SecurityPoolFactory

Deploys every portfolio from pinned creation code and module deployers, and deploys and registers their question ledgers and shared price feeds. No standalone deployment entry point exists. SecurityPoolFactory source contract

Read surface

Each question derives its start bond as max(1 REP, universe theoretical REP supply / 10,000,000). The factory has no standalone vault or debt minima. Deployment requires the configured operations and accounting delegates. securityPoolDeploymentCount and strict securityPoolDeploymentsRange enumerate canonical question ledgers. isPortfolio is true only for a portfolio this factory deployed, and portfolioCreationCodeHash is the hash of the only creation code it deploys. portfolioCount and strict portfoliosRange enumerate, in registration order, the factory-deployed portfolios that have configured their namespace; a deployed portfolio is listed when its final setup step calls initializePortfolioPriceFeed. getPoolId, getSecurityPool, getSecurityPoolOriginId and getSecurityPoolHasInheritedForkOutcome identify their lineage. getPortfolioOriginId includes the caller portfolio namespace. getSecurityPoolPortfolio returns the factory-deployed portfolio a ledger belongs to; sharedPriceFeeds is indexed by portfolio and universe. getChildPoolCoordinator returns the prepared child coordinator, or zero before preparation. maximumReportPriorityFeeAttoEthPerGas exposes the configured coordinator-factory ceiling used to reject over-cap portfolio creation before setup. zoltar identifies the protocol root.

State-changing interactions

Each call lists its parameter names in ABI order. The contract index defines the columns.

Transaction Caller Main prerequisites State or asset effect Primary signals
deployPortfolio(creationCode, configuration) Anyone keccak256(creationCode) equals portfolioCreationCodeHash (Portfolio creation code is not canonical); configuration is exactly 13 words (Portfolio configuration length invalid). The portfolio constructor’s own checks apply and revert the deployment, including that every pinned module deployer holds code. Deploys a SecurityPoolPortfolio whose leading constructor arguments are this factory and its nine pinned module deployers, records it in isPortfolio, and returns its address. The deployment uses CREATE2 with a salt derived from the caller and the number of portfolios that caller has deployed, so the address depends on its creator and no other deployment can occupy it. configuration is the ABI encoding of the origin configuration, question horizon, admission policy and economics, in that order: the only values the creator chooses. PortfolioDeployed with the portfolio and the caller. Setup continues through the portfolio’s prepareNext.
initializePortfolioPriceFeed(universeId, priorityFee) A portfolio this factory deployed, within its own caller-address namespace The universe has a REP token and has not forked. A repeated call must match the first call’s REP token and priority fee. The feed starts without an accepted price. The caller satisfies isPortfolio (Portfolio is not canonical), so no other contract can open a namespace. This call neither registers a question nor allocates REP. The first call creates the caller namespace’s oracle configuration from the universe’s REP token and the priority fee, and appends the caller to the portfolio registry. Each call creates the namespace’s feed for that universe or returns the existing one. Portfolio setup calls this in its last stage, before any question is admitted. Returns the canonical feed address. The first setup emits PortfolioRegistered. Each new feed emits SharedPriceFeedRegistered with the portfolio, universe and feed address.
initializePortfolioPriceFeedForUniverse(universeId) A portfolio, within its own caller-address namespace The caller has configured its namespace; the caller’s portfolio clock recognizes the target universe; the target REP token exists. Creates or retrieves the caller namespace’s feed for an already registered child universe, using the oracle configuration from the namespace’s first initializePortfolioPriceFeed call. No question needs to be deployed first. Returns the canonical feed address. A newly deployed feed emits SharedPriceFeedRegistered.
preparePortfolioPriceFeed(source, universeId) Anyone Canonical portfolio source; the portfolio clock recognizes the target; the target REP token exists. Creates or retrieves a target universe feed in the canonical source pool’s portfolio namespace without moving provider capital. Returns the canonical feed address. A newly deployed feed emits SharedPriceFeedRegistered.
deployPortfolioSecurityPool(universeId, questionId, statoblastSecurityMultiplierBps, initialReportPriorityFeeAttoEthPerGas) A portfolio with a configured namespace, within its own caller-address namespace The caller has configured its namespace (Portfolio configuration missing), which only a factory-deployed portfolio can do. The ordinary origin deployment checks apply; no lineage for this question/configuration has been claimed in the caller namespace. The namespace is derived from msg.sender and cannot be supplied on behalf of another pool. Creates a separate origin ledger and share token in the caller namespace, attaching its coordinator to the namespace/universe shared REP/ETH feed. Portfolio admission calls this from the portfolio contract, after its immutable admission policy allows the question; it then enforces the question horizon, with failure reverting deployment. SharedPriceFeedSet, feed CoordinatorRegistered, SecurityPoolRegistered, and DeploySecurityPool
preparePortfolioChildPriceFeed(parent, outcomeIndex) Anyone The parent is a canonical portfolio ledger in PoolForked state. Its namespace and oracle configuration determine the feed; Zoltar determines the selected child universe and its REP token. Prepares the child universe’s REP token and shared feed in a separate transaction before creating a portfolio child ledger. Repeated preparation returns the same feed without moving capital or selecting any owner’s migration. Returns the canonical child feed address. A newly deployed feed emits SharedPriceFeedRegistered. Child REP deployment may emit Zoltar events.
prepareChildPoolCoordinator(parent, outcomeIndex) Anyone The parent is a canonical ledger in PoolForked state. A portfolio must first prepare its child feed. Missing child REP is deployed through Zoltar. The authenticated factory chain exclusively controls subsequent coordinator binding. Predeploys the canonical child coordinator separately from the question ledger. Repeated calls return the same coordinator. Returns the coordinator address; no DeploySecurityPool until the child ledger is deployed.
deployChildSecurityPool(parent, shareToken, universeId, questionId, statoblastSecurityMultiplierBps) SecurityPoolForker only (Only security pool forker) Parent is the canonical pool for its lineage; supplied share token equals the parent share token; no pool has already been claimed for the parent origin in the target universe; a portfolio child feed has already been prepared; deployment arguments satisfy downstream constructors and wiring. Creates and registers a canonical child question ledger with the parent share token and a coordinator attached to its portfolio branch feed. SecurityPoolRegistered, then DeploySecurityPool
